'''Mannova''' was a terrestrial celestial body located in the [[Mannova system/Legends|Mannova system]], a part of the [[Gordian Reach/Legends|Gordian Reach]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]] in the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. A [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] linked it to the [[Betshish system/Legends|Betshish system]].<ref name="TEA" />

Mannova was used as an industrial dumping ground, resulting in it undergoing an ecological disaster and featuring [[Mountain/Legends|mountains]] of junk on its surface. The astronomical object was [[Homeworld/Legends|home]] to the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Mannovan]] [[Species/Legends|species]], members of which displayed sardonic attitude and were apparently unconcerned about the fate of their homeworld.<ref name="TEA" />

Mannova's junkyards were frequently scoured by speculators and [[Scavenger/Legends|scavengers]] as well as individuals seeking parts that were otherwise impossible to find. During the fighting of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], scavengers brought wrecked [[Starship/Legends|starship]] parts and equipment to Mannova in bulk, resulting in fruitful business for the celestial body's residents.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Mannova was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square Q-5.<ref name="TEA" />
